## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: gh run list --workflow=reconcile-bridge.yml --limit 1 executes without authentication error

## Given / When / Then
**Given**: verify-gha-runner.sh does not yet exist
**When**: tests run with mocked gh CLI
**Then**: tests fail (RED) awaiting implementation

## Acceptance Criteria
- test-verify-gha-runner.sh exists and is executable
- Test case: gh auth success + empty run list → script exits 0 and calls ticket comment
- Test case: gh auth failure → script exits 1 without calling ticket comment
- Test case: gh run list failure (non-auth) → script exits 1
- All tests use mock_gh() to stub CLI calls (no real GitHub API calls)

## File Impact
- tests/scripts/test-verify-gha-runner.sh (CREATE)
